description.narrative: The overall objective of the Project was to improve internal audit and to strengthen the organization by developing and implementing several important policies for good governance within the Platforma team, the planned development of the organization, the promotion and financial management so that the organization could develop sustainably over a long period of time.

Det förberedande kärnstödet för Platforma bereds som en förenklad insats. Syftet med det förberedande kärnstödet är att stärka organisationens kapacitet och utveckla deras interna regelverk.
Platforma kommer under denna första fas av stödet att genomföra prioriterade rekommendationer från Swedish Development Advisors från system based audit rapporten framtagen 2020. Därför kommer Platforma att utveckla institutionell kapacitet, interna rutiner, personalkunskaper och andra färdigheter för att kunna genomföra kärnstödsaktiviteter. Baserat på en kommande uppföljningsrapport som avser aktiviteter under denna första fas (rapport tas preliminärt fram i december 2021) kan Sida sedan överväga att fortsätta med kärnstöd till Platforma baserat på en strategisk plan, resultatram och den strategiska budgeten som utvecklats inför kärnstödet.
Insatsens totala budget uppgår till 225 050 SEK.

The pre-core support granted for Platforma is a simplified contribution which aims at supporting the organization to develop its internal capacities and policies.
During preparatory support phase Platforma will implement priority recommendations provided by the Swedish Development Advisors in the system-based audit report produced in 2020. Therefore, it will develop institutional capacities, internal routines, staff knowledge and skills to be able to implement core-support activities. Based on a follow-up report on pre-core activities to be conducted tentatively in December 2021, Sida may consider continuing with core-support with Platforma based on the Strategic Plan, RAF and strategic budget developed during pre-core support.
The interventions' total budget is 225 050 SEK.

Platformas strategic planning process was conducted in a participatory manner. Platforma has integrated the gender equality perspective well in both Strategic Documents.
Platforma has made good progress in integrating the cross-cutting perspectives. Gender equality is considered fully integrated. The HRBA is quite visible in Platformas identity and themes, particularly the third theme, but not explicitly applied. Environment is also partly integrated in Platformas identity and themes, but lacking in the context analysis, RAF and organisational development. The conflict perspective has not been integrated.
The financial sustainability of Platforma is challenging and it remains dependent on short-term donor grants.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
